title: Virtua Fighter Remix
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター・リミックス
overview:
Those amazing fighters are back! The fight never ends...

The acclaimed "VF" evolves from polygons to texture mapping! The fierce battles remain just as they were...

Virtua Fighter Remix brings the 3D arcade fighter back with fully texture-mapped fighters, while the core fighting is left unchanged. Pick one of eight martial artists, including Akira, Jacky, Sarah, Lau and Pai, and battle through the field to reach Dural, the final opponent.

Every move comes from a stick and just three buttons - punch, kick and guard. Matches are best of three rounds: win by knockout, by forcing your opponent off the edge of the ring, or by having more health left when time runs out.

- 1-2 players
- Eight selectable fighters
- Ring outs and timed rounds
- Memory backup support

あのスゴイヤツらが帰ってきた!
闘いは終わらない…。

好評の「VF」がポリゴンからテクスチャーマッピングへと進化!
熱き闘いはそのままに…。
